entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SQLite: align JSON and M.D.Sqlite representations #36749
    Backlog
  • SQL Server: ExecuteUpdate_within_json_to_nonjson_column tests failing with Unexpected character '⸤' #36746
    Backlog

Closed

  • Refactor BuiltInDataTypes #27650
  • SQL Server: new JSON_VALUE() RETURNING clause is incompatible with uniqueidentifier, geometry/geography #36627
  • Error "An item with the same key has already been added" with JSON columns #35338
  • The issue of supporting unique index for the macaddr column in Entity Framework Core #36748
  • Regression in EF Core 8: Contains() with small string array generates invalid OPENJSON SQL #36695
  • DbContext.EnsureCreatedAsync takes ~12secs #36675
  • EF Core generates an IDENTITY column when a owned entity has an int in its composite key. #36705
  • Random timeout requiring managed identity to get new token #36715
  • Issues when performing many-to-many relationships through existing database tables #36718
  • Issue while performing null check in where clause in linq for a non-nullable string property #35058

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36752
  • Add comprehensive test coverage for FrozenSet #36751
  • [rc2] Fix dotnet-ef migrations bundle command on Linux #36750
    ask-mode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36745

Merged

  • [rc2] Revert to stable MSBuild and Roslyn versions #36742
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36747
  • [rc2] Stop using JSON_VALUE() RETURNING for uniqueidentifier on SQL Server 2025 #36740
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Support arbitrary values in ExecuteUpdate JSON for SQL Server #36730
    ask-mode
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36744
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36743
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36733

Updated

  • [rc2] Introduce SqlEngineDbContextOptionsBuilderBase to allow unified registration of extension over SQL Server, Azure SQL and Synapse. #36737
  • Add transactional batch support to cosmos provider #36693
    community-contribution
  • Better cast/convert support for Cosmos #35000
    community-contribution
  • Add proper handling when a property’s backing field cannot be inferred or the unsafe accessor cannot be generated. #36720
